name: starnet-chibi-character
description: Locked recipe for generating diverse but format-identical agent characters (cute chibi, high-top-down). Only the character `description` changes between characters; everything else is fixed so every character is the same size, proportions, view and animation set.

pixellab_create_character._note: standard mode is REQUIRED — it is the only mode that respects fixed `proportions`, which is what guarantees every character is the same build/size. pro/v3 ignore proportions and would vary.

blink.edit_description: both eyes fully closed, blinking, relaxed closed eyelids

sit.edit_description: sitting down with knees bent in front, upright posture, hands resting forward as if typing, NO chair, NO desk, no furniture at all, same slim body size
sit._note: NEVER mention chair/desk — the game has its own chair+workstation props; a baked-in chair makes the agent look ~40% wider when seated

type.action_description: typing on a keyboard, both hands moving up and down, seated
type._source: run on the (chairless) sit state id; do NOT say 'at a desk' or it bakes a desk in

postprocess.far_eye_fix: Run fix_eyes.py on every east/west frame (idle, blink, sit, walk). Pixellab side profiles often render a stray SECOND eye on the back of the head; fix_eyes paints it out with fur, keeping the near eye + ears. assemble_character.py expects already-fixed frames.

output.anchor: feet centered horizontally; single registration transform from base south applied to ALL frames so nothing jitters
